notes: Native CoreText/AppKit glyph paths; no font files copied or uploaded.
All coordinates are absolute in the recorded source viewport.
Paths inherit fill from the parent SVG wrapper.
No width scaling applied; compare exports before claiming pixel identity.
Explicit CSS Tahoma cascade and variable SFNS weight preserve browser fallback and weight650.
Arabic joining runs suppress letter spacing; spacing and Latin runs retain it.

Validated DOM baselines are authoritative; exact-style measured ascent is used for equivalent runs whose marker changed only horizontal whitespace. Canvas and CoreText alternatives remain available for comparison.
